research_question: Under what measurement-model assumptions is optical resolution diffraction bounded, and what evidence should support a credible claim beyond the conventional far-field baseline?
selected_idea_title: TraceRes: A Task-Specific Resolution Passport for Credible Optical Nanoscopy
central_conclusion: Diffraction imposes a real transfer or separation bound for a specified conventional linear far-field imaging model, but it is not a universal numerical ceiling on every optical inference task.
human_review_items: Confirm direct publisher-page details for the frozen DOI registry when the in-app browser ACL issue is resolved.

Execute the proposed blinded truth-known benchmark before assigning structural-resolution-validated status to a biological claim.
